hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts quarterly DPO extension paired with annual principal debt/revenue burden relief may identify companies funding growth through operating supplier credit rather than balance-sheet leverage, producing next-open 10-day continuation value.

nearest.reopen_condition: A retry needs materially different PIT debt evidence, such as maturity cliff relief, covenant-risk reduction, parsed refinancing terms, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep debt tags, debt/revenue thresholds, revenue-growth floor, annual fact freshness, price guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

A retry needs materially different PIT supplier-financing evidence such as supplier concentration, early-payment discounts, supply-chain contract terms, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep the payable/COGS tag list, DPO extension threshold, COGS/gross-profit growth floor, fact freshness, price guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

A retry needs materially different PIT tax evidence such as durable cash-tax normalization, tax-credit provenance, or post-filing analyst estimate revisions confirming after-tax earnings power. Do not sweep tax-burden thresholds, pretax/revenue growth floors, annual fact freshness, tag lists, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

A retry needs materially different PIT evidence such as accrued-liability decomposition linked to named cost programs, litigation/restructuring resolution text, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep accrued-liability tags, burden thresholds, fact freshness, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

A retry needs materially different PIT asset-light evidence, such as capex-to-D&A replacement-cycle context, fixed-asset turnover by industry, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep D&A tags, D&A/revenue thresholds, revenue floor, freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

novelty.new_evidence_axis: Cross-statement intersection of two previously separate PIT raw SEC Companyfacts fields: quarterly accounts-payable DPO extension plus annual principal debt/revenue burden relief on the same signal date; no prior experiment tested the joint operating-credit-with-deleveraging gate.

prediction.confidence_reason: Standalone accounts-payable DPO extension and principal debt burden relief each showed strong late/mid evidence but failed risk or old-window guards. The new test is the same-date cross-statement intersection: supplier financing must be paired with deleveraging. The main disconfirmer is thin overlap and repeated saturation in raw Companyfacts candidate pools.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until one shared default-off helper computes the same PIT accounts-payable DPO extension, principal debt/revenue burden relief, price confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
